The vibe

A quiet retreat in the middle of the city

Step through the archway and the traffic falls away. Zahid Inn is built around two shaded courtyards where the loudest sound is water in the fountain and tea being poured. Hand-cut tile, warm brick, and low buildings hold onto the calm of the old quarter.

Mornings begin slowly on the patio, afternoons are for a book in the shade, and evenings settle in under the lanterns. You are minutes from the metro and the markets, yet it feels like a world of its own.

Location & neighborhood

Ten minutes on foot from Khamid Alimjan metro station

Zahid Inn sits just a 10-minute walk from Khamid Alimjan metro station, putting the whole of Tashkent within easy reach. Right nearby you'll find some of the city's most enjoyable spots to relax and explore:

  • Mirzo Ulugbek Central Park — 600 m, a perfect place for a calm stroll and time in nature.
  • Eco Park — 800 m, open green space for fresh air and scenic walks.
  • "More" Water Park — 600 m, a great spot for fun and a refreshing swim.
  • "Ashkhabad" Amusement Park — 1.4 km, rides and attractions for the whole family.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know before you arrive

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 12:00 PM. Our front desk is staffed 24 hours, so early arrivals and late departures can be arranged in advance — just let us know your plans.

Is breakfast included?

Yes. A freshly prepared breakfast is included with every room and served each morning on the main patio.

Do you offer airport transfers?

We do. Pickup and drop-off can be arranged on request for an additional fee — send us your flight details over Telegram or email and we'll take care of the rest.

Is parking available?

Yes — we have a private lot on site, and parking is free for our guests.

How far is the metro and city center?

Khamid Alimjan metro station is about a 10-minute walk away, connecting you to the whole city. Several parks and attractions are within walking distance of the hotel.

How can I get the best rate?

Booking directly through us gives you the best available price with no added fees. Use the booking button at the top of the page or message us on Telegram.

Ready for a quieter stay?

Rates from $45/night. Book directly for the best price, no fees.
